In the waters off Mumbai, alongside waves, fish, and boats, one might now also see large advertising hoardings floating about. The Maharashtra Maritime Board has issued tenders for the installation of floating advertising platforms and hoardings along Mumbai’s coastline. Locations such as Juhu Beach, the Bandra-Worli Sea Link, and Lotus Jetty are included in this plan. The government states that this will generate revenue for ports and water transport; however, the proposal has already sparked controversy.
